thread:
Lina Morales: Heads-up — RadiantCo renewal hit procurement delay. PO isn't in place, risking onboarding timeline. Committed 12 seats; planned enablement 2024-05-10. Procurement asking for net90 and a vendor code; legal flagged an IP/indemnity redline. @Owen Patel any flexibility on term/pricing for net90? Also need a fallback for signatures (e-sign vs wet). 

Owen Patel: We might shift to a 9-month term instead of annual to keep ARR alignment. Approve prorate on first invoice. Need revops buy-in. @Maya Chen can revops accept net90? :eyes:

Maya Chen: RevOps can accept net90 only with vendor code and a 2% processing fee to cover longer payment windows. Vendor code available but we need PO + signature before 2024-05-06 to keep the 5/10 enablement. 

Lina Morales: Customer said CFO insists on PO. They're also pushing to remove our indemnity clause. Legal will not likely accept removal. If we can't get a PO by 5/6 we should plan to shift enablement. @Paul Rivera can we provide a trimmed self-service onboarding to keep momentum?

Paul Rivera: We can provision a self-serve starter onboarding and keep CS check-ins. But if seats aren't active by 5/17 they may request timeline push. I'll offer a short async enablement plan as stopgap. :calendar:

Sasha (Legal): Can't remove indemnity entirely. We can offer limited carveouts and narrow language. Looping in @Ethan (Legal) for suggested text. :warning:

Ethan (Legal): Dropping proposed alt indemnity now into the shared doc: ```Proposed indemnity (customer-facing): "Each party will indemnify the other against direct losses resulting from gross negligence or willful misconduct; intellectual property claims will be handled per Section 8 with mutual limitations."``` Need legal review; estimate 24h.

Maya Chen: RevOps confirms vendor code present. They will process net90 with 2% fee but require PO+signature in hand by 2024-05-06 to keep enablement window. 

Lina Morales: Pricing ask: customer requested a 10% first-year discount + prorated first invoice. Can we counter?

Owen Patel: Approve up to 8% discount + prorate. 10% requires director sign-off. Suggest 8% if they sign by 2024-05-04. 

Lina Morales: I'll propose 8% + prorate + net90 with 2% processing fee and the legal carveouts. I'll update the doc and send. Planning to ask for e-sign with PO attachment to speed routing. 

contract-bot: Document emailed to RadiantCo CFO and Legal with link to DocSend (expires in 7 days). :thumbsup:

Lina Morales: Thanks all — I'll post updates here as soon as I have confirmation from the customer.
